title.narrative: Youth-focused policies and programs Central America

description.narrative: UNESCO will strengthen youth stakeholder capacities, generate knowledge on challenges faced by young people, and support youth-led actions and networks to develop and implement youth-focused policies and programmes. Reflecting UNESCO's unified Sciences Sector, the office will position young people as both producers of knowledge and agents of evidence-based policy change through three interconnected lines of action: implementing Youth As Researchers in at least one coverage country to train young people, with priority to young women, indigenous, and Afro-descendant youth, to conduct transdisciplinary research on challenges affecting their communities and translate findings into policy-relevant knowledge products; equipping governments in at least two countries with the UNESCO Toolbox for Youth Policy and Programming through training workshops and intergenerational policy dialogues; and leading the regional dissemination of the 1st UNESCO Global Youth Outlook to inform national policy decisions across the coverage area. The Office will encourage youth participation in major international events, and follow-up accompaniment to initiatives brought forward by the region's participants in Youth Forums.
